name: Anti-capitalism
summary: Anti-capitalism is the umbrella label for opposition to capitalism and its practices, whether to curb its worst effects or to replace it with another system. What it shares is the opposition itself; the sources record no common programme on ownership, markets, the state or method.
scope: The umbrella as such, defined by dictionary usage and by a movement charter's statement of what it opposes (the World Social Forum, cited as a statement of opposition only, not as a source of answers). Marxist, anarchist, mutualist, green and other strands have their own entries and are not used to answer here.
